name: Warrior
description: A strong melee fighter specializing in weapons and heavy armor.

name: Mage
description: A master of arcane magic who uses spells to defeat enemies.

name: Rogue
description: A stealthy and agile character who excels in critical strikes.

name: Cleric
description: A divine spellcaster who heals allies and fights undead.

name: Paladin
description: A holy warrior combining combat skills with divine magic.

name: Ranger
description: A skilled hunter who uses ranged weapons and nature magic.

name: Warlock
description: A spellcaster who gains power through a pact with a mysterious entity.

name: Barbarian
description: A fierce warrior driven by rage and raw physical power.

name: Bard
description: A charismatic performer who uses music and magic to support allies.

name: Monk
description: A disciplined fighter who uses martial arts and inner energy.
